instincts.action: scripts/lib/ must remain strictly stdlib-only. No third-party packages or circular imports.
instincts.rationale: Enforces scripts/verify.py --lint-imports and ensures hooks execute within 3s budget.

instincts.action: Never invoke datetime now or time time directly; always route through lib.clock.
instincts.rationale: Enforces scripts/verify.py --lint-clock so deterministic virtual time simulation works (D6).

instincts.action: All security controls, kill switches, and adapter failures must fail-closed (I12).
instincts.rationale: An unreadable or unreachable safety check must be treated as active/refused.

instincts.action: Every executed task must emit a valid receipt with status and evidence before completion (I3).
instincts.rationale: Enforces audit trail and prevents rogue unverified operations.

instincts.action: Never persist raw secrets. All values must be sanitized via lib.redact (I6).
instincts.rationale: Prevents credential leakage into repository or event logs.

instincts.action: Every adapter in adapters/ must have a matching fake in sim/fakes/ passing adapters/contract.py.
instincts.rationale: Enforces airgapped simulation capability for ?16 scenarios.

instincts.action: Always assert on expected behavior explicitly, never leave empty asserts.
